summary: Boundary County site under the Kaniksu National Forest; a cabin is listed for 1933 and Robert Saarf for 1934; later called abandoned, and no source describes it today.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as gone; both lookout sites say abandoned with no date; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts files the site as hike-in

events.note: Cabin listed for 1933 on both lookout sites
Robert Saarf named as lookout; Idaho Fire Lookouts cites the Bonners Ferry Herald, dated 06/07/1934

evidence.supports: six miles southwest of Bonners Ferry
listed under the Kaniksu National Forest
Robert Saarf named as known lookout personnel for 1934
Robert Saarf named for 1934, citing the Bonners Ferry Herald dated 06/07/1934
legal location township 61 north, range 1 west, section 9

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list says Gone; Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com say Abandoned, with no date. The story reports both wordings and does not say whether anything stands.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1933 cabin entry, a 1934 name, and an abandonment tag with no date. The 1934 name is cited second-hand through Idaho Fire Lookouts; the Bonners Ferry Herald itself was not read. Idaho Fire Lookouts spells the forest 'Kanisku'; the correct spelling is used. Forest Lookouts gives the legal location as 61N-1W-9; the story spells it out as township 61 north, range 1 west, section 9. No photos found.
